_note: Display-only glosses, 'lemma|pos' (shipped words.json lemma and pos) -> en. Applied after ranking, example selection and linking (core/words.apply_gloss_display): senses here never change links or examples. Use gloss_overrides.json for senses that should steer linking and example choice.
_coupling: A display entry replaces the whole en shipped for its word. jalan, kereta, makan, masa, masuk, orang, rumah, salah, sepak, tata and tempat also have a pre-polish entry in gloss_overrides.json (which steers linking and example choice). Their display text repeats that override (e.g. orang's "(classifier for people)") plus the compound sense, so edit both together.
orang|noun: person, people; (classifier for people); (orang tua) parents
rumah|noun: house, home; (rumah sakit) hospital; (rumah makan) restaurant
ruang|noun: room, space; (ruang tamu) living room; (ruang tunggu) waiting room
makan|verb: to eat; (makan siang) lunch; (makan malam) dinner
masuk|verb: to enter, to come in; (masuk akal) to make sense, reasonable
dasar|noun: base, basis; primary (sekolah dasar = primary school)
bakar|verb: to burn; grilled (ikan bakar = grilled fish)
jalan|noun: road, street; way; (jalan-jalan) streets; to go for a walk
